description.value: Sparkes Corn Barn is a family-owned farm stand that has grown and sold fresh sweet corn in the Chilliwack area since 1998, operating a network of distinctive green-and-yellow drive-thru roadside barns across the Fraser Valley. All corn is non-GMO, picked fresh daily, and sold the same day directly from their own fields. During the summer harvest season, cyclists will also find locally grown strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries at the stands.

No bike-specific amenities or facilities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
